title: Why Octopuses Have 3 Hearts (And Barely Use Them)
description: A quick, original breakdown of octopus cardiovascular biology -- AI-narrated commentary, not a repost. #Shorts

beats.text: Octopuses have three hearts, and it's stranger than you think.
Two hearts pump blood to the gills, one pumps it to the rest of the body.
That third heart actually stops beating when the octopus swims.
That's why octopuses prefer crawling over swimming, it's less exhausting.
Evolution really said: three hearts, but only when you're lazy.
